= GitHub Workflows

This repository is a *reserved placeholder* in the Stealth Glider line. It
ships exactly the two workflows its shipped siblings run, pinned to the same
standards reusables by full commit SHA (the metadatastician org requires SHA
pinning):

* `secret-scanner.yml` — `hyperpolymath/standards` secret-scanner reusable.
* `scorecard.yml` — OpenSSF Scorecard via the standards reusable.

Every other template workflow was removed at mint rather than left to fail
over an empty tree. Add workflows back when content lands, and pin them.
